messages:
Samir (sales): Hey team, Mosaic sent back the RFP — they want a clear matrix showing feature parity across Hosted / Dedicated / Private + a data residency/failover plan. They also asked for POC pricing tiers and whether HSM-backed keys can be used. Can we turn around a concise response by EOD tomorrow?
Maya R.: I can draft the matrix. Quick q: are they expecting cross-region failover (active-active) or just DR in another region?
Samir (sales): Their note says 'low-latency local reads + automatic failover to secondary region within 30s' — so sounds like active-primary + fast-failover.
Kevin L.: We can support active-primary with async replication between Dedicated pools. Active-active at low-latency across continents is tough without edge caching. For US-only (us-west-2 <-> us-east-1) we can meet ~30s failover SLA with health-check + reroute.
Ashley P.: On HSM: yes, we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations for Private and Dedicated. For Hosted we offer a hosted KMS option; BYOK is available for Dedicated and Private. Need to confirm whether Mosaic requires FIPS-certified HSM or just KMS-backed envelopes.
Maya R.: I'll put that in the matrix text: "Hosted: hosted KMS, no customer HSM; Dedicated: BYOK w/ KMS/HSM support (FIPS optional); Private: full HSM/KMS integration" — want to include a note about cert rotation cadence?
Samir (sales): Yes, they asked about cert rotation and audit logs. Add rotation policies (30/90 days) and that audit logs are exportable to customer SIEM.
Kevin L.: For the POC: we can spin up a 2-GPU Dedicated pool in us-west-2 for 2 weeks. Estimated cost: $5k flat + per-token usage normal. Or offer a hosted trial with throttled throughput and sample dataset. Which does Mosaic prefer?
Samir (sales): They prefer dedicated to validate latencies. Offer both options and state recommended path (Dedicated POC then Private uplift if they want on-prem).
Maya R.: I'll attach the capability matrix and a short one-page ops playbook in the response. Draft items I'm adding:
- Feature parity table (generation, streaming, embeddings, function-calling, kv cache)
- Performance SLOs by region
- Failover behavior and expected RTO/RPO
- Security controls: SSO, SCIM, MFA, BYOK, HSM, audit logs
- POC pricing and trial commit options
- Required technical contacts + network whitelisting checklist
Samir (sales): Also include a short excerpt answering their security questionnaire Q12 about key custody: "Customer keys remain under customer control for Dedicated/Private via BYOK; Hosted uses envelope encryption with Redwood-managed root".
Ashley P.: I'll drop the exact wording and link to the SOC2/FedRAMP progress note. Also we need Mosaic to fill out the network questionnaire for IP allowlists + whether they need private peering.
Maya R.: Drafting now. Uploading matrix: mosaic_rfp_matrix_v1.xlsx (preview) :eyes:
deploy-bot: build:docs-preview succeeded for sales/rfps (sha: a1b2c3)
Kevin L.: Small technical note for the matrix: for KV cache warmup we recommend sample traffic or using our `prefill` API: `POST /v1/prefill` with model and prompt sets to warm KV store. Will add sample curl in matrix snippet.
Maya R.: good call — adding curl snippet. Samir — want me to propose commit tiers (2-week eval, 1-month trial, 3-month POC with discounted reserved capacity)?
Samir (sales): Yes. Lay out pricing clearly: evaluation (two-week) — $5k flat; 1-month trial — $10k credit; 3-month POC — 20% off reserved pricing. Include cancellation terms.
Maya R.: Will do. Sending draft to Ashley + Kevin for signoff, then I'll send to Mosaic with attachment and a 1-page exec summary. ETA: finished draft in ~2 hours. :thumbsup:
Ashley P.: I'll review security phrasing and add the FedRAMP timeline.
Kevin L.: I'll sanity-check the failover numbers and the POC playbook steps.
Samir (sales): Awesome — thanks. If anyone sees blockers (e.g., HSM cert requirement > FIPS), flag now so we don't miss it in the RFP response.
Maya R.: noted. uploading final draft shortly.
Samir (sales): thx all :clap:
